title: Arithmetic-Step and Exact-Rational Finite-Witness Certification for Hitting Time Index Bounds, the Degree Threshold, and Lollipop Counterexamples
abstract: We present a machine-checked arithmetic kernel and zero-float exact rational finite-witness certificate suite (HT-INDEX-CERT-1.0) auditing key algebraic steps and concrete graph witnesses from Palacios, Tamura, Wiberg, and Petojevic (arXiv:2611.34295v1). Our artifact combines an 18-theorem constructive Lean 4.35.0 arithmetic kernel (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier solving exact rational hitting-time linear systems over Q, 16 canonical JSON certificates (C01-C16) covering 15 finite witness graphs plus one closed-form point, and 39 unit and forgery-rejection tests. Strictly distinguishing Lean's decoupled natural-number arithmetic lemmas from finite-instance rational linear-system audits, we verify K_6 minimality, the K_4-with-two-pendants non-comparability witness (262/3 > 82), finite threshold witnesses separating K_{5,5} from 2K_r+e (r in {5,7}), the minimal disproof HT(P_6)=223 < 224=HT(L(6,4)), exact rational lollipop values through n=10 (933/2, 4354/5, 7632/5, 7595/3), and L(4k,2k) quintic lower-bound formulas and finite solves.
